questions.ar: هل سبق أن شُخِّصت أو أُبلغت بنقص في أي من العناصر الغذائية الأساسية (مثل فيتامين ب١٢ أو الحديد أو فيتامين د)؟

questions.en: Have you experienced any recent or unexplained changes in appetite, weight, or digestion?
questions.ar: هل لاحظت أي تغيّرات حديثة أو غير مبرّرة في الشهية أو الوزن أو الهضم؟

questions.en: Have you ever experienced tension, including feelings of tension, fatigue, startle response, being moved to tears easily, trembling, feelings of restlessness, or inability to relax?

questions.en: Have you ever experienced unusual body sensations, such as ringing in the ears, blurry vision, hot or cold flashes, feeling weak, or a tingling or prickling sensation?

questions.en: Do you feel that you have a support system you can rely on (e.g., friends, family, community)?
